source: ADR-365 AC-8 (D11): the exhaustion cost of a negative claim over a market-sized set. The file's set is Grubber's Market during the `calm` state, read off grubbers-market.chord and wares.chord 2026-10-10: the fourteen market rooms plus Commerce Street (so the guarded east exit is tried), the twenty-six takeable wares (every entity whose states are shelved/nicked, less the wooden box at the Red Gate office), and take/drop. The four smaller claims are the same statement over a take-only subset of the wares, to measure how exhaustion scales with the number of independent wares. Budget stated before the run: --max-states 300000 --max-seconds 600 --max-depth 60 per walk.
